# r0

r0 is a desktop code editor built with Rust, Tauri, and React. See the project repository for current capabilities, supported platforms, installation instructions, and releases.

## Links

- Website: https://r0-ide.vercel.app
- Project repository: https://github.com/Adshkumar/r0
- Releases: https://github.com/Adshkumar/r0/releases
- Issues: https://github.com/Adshkumar/r0/issues
- Documentation: https://r0-ide.vercel.app/docs
- Changelog: https://r0-ide.vercel.app/changelog

The website's Git panel is an illustrative preview, not a live view of a repository. This site does not publish independent performance benchmarks.
